_comment: The enchant, buckle and gem list in data/enchants.json is scraped from the database, including
the effect wording and the stats parsed out of it. This file only exists to correct or annotate
individual entries where that parse is wrong or needs explaining.
Keys are the enchant name exactly as data/enchants.json records it. A 'note' is shown to the
user; any stat keys replace the scraped ones entirely.
Proc and timed effects are already excluded by the scraper and shown as unscored, so they do
_alsoIncludeComment: Attachments fetched by item id rather than found by search.
The scraper finds most enchants by searching the database, and search is the weak link: it
answers with a bot-protection page often enough that a term coming back empty proves nothing.
A search for 'Zandalar Signet' - which certainly exists - returned nothing on the same run that
missed these. Item pages fetch reliably, so anything named here is fetched directly.
Add an id and the next --attachments run picks it up: the name, effect wording, slot and stats
all come off the item's own page. The 'name' here is only a comment for the reader.
